text: 🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine
🛡️ The shield wall forms — strongest arms to The Algorithm. The small teeth can wait their turn.
🛡️ Nathan follows a woman, maybe 40s, with a nervous tic in — The Algorithm still stands.
🛡️ The shield wall forms — strongest arms to The Reunion, The Eulogy, The Eulogy. The small teeth can wait their turn.
🛡️ Giulia follows a woman, maybe 40s in — The Reunion still stands.
